notes.title: Release 1.0!
notes.content:
[p]Next Wednesday (9/10), Monkey Math will be leaving Early Access behind and releasing version 1.0!
Surely everyone will be done with Silksong and will be looking for a new game.

There's a lot of polishing and bug fixing going into this update, I had some plans for some other mini-games but that can be post 1.0, I don't want to be a perpetual EA game.  EA was really meant for me to learn the ropes of the Steam store page and releasing a game and what a journey it's been!

Thanks for playing,[/p][p]ScienceRobot
[/p]

notes.title: 0.5.0 Plans
notes.content:
With the release of build 0.4.0 it's time to discuss what's next.  I think I have the initial 'bones' of the game complete that I originally designed but now it's time to do some janitorial work.

Build 0.5.0 will bring lots of sprite cleanup and in a lot of areas, complete redesign of some levels.  
I want to bring this game back to looking more like an NES game but I found I'm using some styles that are more SNES than NES like I originally envisioned.

Lab level changes for example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/f8d87a37431a74847314f7e8ca8e917c68b21dc5.jpg[/img]

Redesign:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/35cee33f63c648d8f330cd272186c552375541ce.png[/img]

Using a proper NES color palette cleans up the level nicely.

I'll also be redesigning the exercise level that harkens back the DK Jr. Math exercise level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/27bb1fdedabeca2a042adb7c047c8d46b074d8d2.png[/img]

While all this cleanup is going on I'll also be working on the Online PvP mode, outside of Steam Remote Play.  Depending on how that goes I hope that will be ready by 0.6.0.  I want to stick to focusing on cleaning up some areas in 0.5.0 first.

More to come, thanks for playing.
-ScienceRobot

notes.title: Build 0.4.0 Preview
notes.content:
Build 0.4.0 is on the horizon here's a preview of what's to come.

Division Exercise:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/b5d292a7b777be9f5a917acda88aeb7bb41b208c.jpg[/img]

This one has taken some time, I was really trying to make it much simpler than the way DK Jr. Math handled it on NES.  You can simply put in the answer as you would any other exercise or you can use the next line button and enter in the remainders to help you solve it.  I wanted to keep both options there and not make it a requirement to "show your work."  

World 3 (Factory)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/f8988d0012db6cc4c3f647e738f555ba7d4b902f.jpg[/img]

Another Story update, this will have 3 new levels and a boss and secret level to uncover. 

Compound Inequality Minigame
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/4bffd46670f6af0a599fcb1f7df44a2b5dd8bcc9.jpg[/img]

Featured in World 3 Level 3, this will have players solve inequalities and solve for X. This is still the most WIP at the moment so this may change slightly as I continue to tweak it (as is most content in EA).

I'm hoping to finalize 0.4.0 in the next couple weeks!

Thanks for playing,
ScienceRobot

Pi day is upon us so I figured that would be an appropriate date for the next build, 0.3.0.

New extras menu where you can find the Pi Challenge as well as the side-scrolling car chase challenge.  Any future mini-games will go here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/1d9c77f0244c72d0483f15a96d3d1c309ef0ee07.jpg[/img]

Pi Challenge will task you with collecting the correct next digit of Pi that spawns from the top.  I [i]only[/i] went to 100 digits, hopefully that is enough for most people.  We can get crazier in the future if need be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/974dde32d885978322bc29acba2f35d99d0d9b11.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, behind the scenes there are 'scoring zones', so if you're confident enough in your answer and on the right vine you can get the highest multiplier for your score. Aim for a high score and bragging rights!

notes.title: Build 0.2.0
notes.content:
As the journey of Early Access continues, I want to build upon the core of what DK Jr. Math offered as well as add more variety and build upon a fun and unique story mode.

First, multiplication has been added to the exercise game mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/6181ebfb60a0e1a83e6cca29bfa537b0a1f545ba.png[/img]

One difference between how multiplication works in Monkey Math vs. what you'd see in DK Jr. Math is the ability to quickly switch to the next digit row as you figure out the problem, DK Jr. Math sort of locked you in on that row and walked you through it, making it a little difficult to go back and fix mistakes.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/7ac056214babff4cfd6c84341416427405dddda4.png[/img]
The 'next block' will handle row changing.

Second, story mode world 2 is shaping up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/daea39dd0b34011cc7ad06c828710c53eb958ac8.png[/img]

In addition to world 2 I'm introducing a new level that will break some of the mundane math equations to solve and mix it up.  Level 2-3 will be an endless runner type game where you have to collect numbers as you run from the vehicle until you reach 0. I plan to keep making these little 'mini-games' to mix things up throughout the game and probably incorporate them into the 'Misc.' category in Exercise Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161587/87a345600eb6757b8f9eaf4627f708696175c9ff.png[/img]

I'm aiming to release Build 0.2.0 Feb 12th.

Thanks for playing,
ScienceRobot

The demo for Monkey Math is available for download now!
Included in the demo is 'Classic Mode' which will be familiar to DK Jr. Math enthusiasts, a story mode with 2 levels and a boss battle (if you happen to find the secret), and an exercise mode where you can solve addition/subtraction and a few miscellaneous math quiz questions.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
We have arrived on the Steam Store! Now what?

The first step is to get the demo ready before the next Steam Next Fest (Oct).  I plan on having this demo ready well before then and available to download.  I still need to nail down what I want to include in the demo so there may be several iterations of the demo leading up to the Next Fest but once that hits I'll be putting more focus on the first Early Access build.

In some ways, the Early Access build is ready and the demo will just be a subset of features from that but I want to turn focus onto building out the Store Page and getting a solid demo ready first, but rest assured, the Early Access build will come soon after the Next Fest barring any major setbacks like not actually being able to run the game on a potato.

Thanks for checking out Monkey Math, more updates to come.
-ScienceRobot
